title: Technical SEO Audit Rules Specification
description: Deterministic rule definitions, issue severity classifications, and trigger conditions for the SEO crawler.

rules.title: Protocol or hostname variants do not converge
rules.description: All HTTP/HTTPS and www/non-www variants must reach one single preferred canonical URL.

rules.title: Redirect chain detected
rules.description: URL requires multiple hops before reaching the final destination.

rules.title: Internal URL returns an error
rules.description: Internal link returned HTTP status 4xx or 5xx.

rules.title: Canonical tag is missing
rules.description: HTML page does not declare a rel='canonical' tag.

rules.title: Multiple canonical tags found
rules.description: HTML page contains more than one rel='canonical' tag.

rules.title: Canonical points elsewhere
rules.description: The declared canonical URL differs from the current page URL.

rules.title: Duplicate page title
rules.description: The same <title> element appears on multiple distinct crawled pages.

rules.title: Duplicate page bodies found
rules.description: Multiple URLs contain effectively identical HTML text bodies.

rules.title: Parameter-generated URL space detected
rules.description: Uncontrolled GET parameters multiply crawlable URL space without canonicalization or noindex.

rules.title: Sitemap URL is not crawlable
rules.description: A URL listed in the sitemap returned an HTTP error or fetch failure.

rules.title: Sitemap URL redirects
rules.description: A URL listed in the sitemap redirects to another URL instead of listing the final canonical target directly.

rules.title: Crawlable pages are absent from the sitemap
rules.description: Valid indexable 200 OK pages found during crawling are missing from the XML sitemap.
